title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons: Early Payment Discount Rate Tied to the Homeowner Contract
content:
For a rider of the Optional Coverage Add-Ons, the corrected discount rate used for the rider's premium billing correction follows how early the latest premium payment on the base Homeowner Service Contracts contract posted. The measure is the number of days from that payment's posting date to that contract's current term start date.

| Latest premium payment on the base homeowner contract | Corrected discount rate |
|---|---|
| Posted 30 or more days before the term start date | 0.14 (14 percent) |
| Posted 15 or more, but fewer than 30, days before the term start date | 0.12 (12 percent) |
| Posted fewer than 15 days before the term start date | The rider's published annual pay discount rate |
| Posted on or after the term start date | The rider's published annual pay discount rate |
| No premium payment on file for the base homeowner contract | The rider's published annual pay discount rate |
| The rider's base is not a homeowner contract | The rider's published annual pay discount rate |

The payment read is the latest premium payment on the rider's own base homeowner contract, as its billing history shows; earlier payments, and payments on any other contract the customer holds, do not count.

## Boundary days (hypothetical dates, homeowner term start date 1 March, in a year whose February has 28 days)

| Posting date of the latest premium payment on the base homeowner contract | Days before 1 March | Corrected discount rate |
|---|---|---|
| 30 January | 30 | 0.14 |
| 31 January | 29 | 0.12 |
| 14 February | 15 | 0.12 |
| 15 February | 14 | The rider's published annual pay discount rate |
| 1 March | 0 | The rider's published annual pay discount rate |

**Hypothetical case.** The latest premium payment on a rider's base homeowner contract posted 45 days before that contract's term began. The corrected discount rate for the rider is 0.14.
